d2_questions: Determine whether trend persistence is supported by durable fundamental change rather than expectations alone.
Test whether the expected return remains attractive after normalizing current momentum.
Normalize earnings and cash flow using the latest primary financial disclosures.
Build an explicit valuation range and identify what expectations are embedded in the current price.
Define the first-rejection test and the evidence that would invalidate the thesis.
queue.first_rejection: Reject D2 promotion if normalized fundamentals do not support the market signal or valuation eliminates the expected-return advantage.

catalysts: FDA import alert is formally removed and U.S. syringe shipments normalize.
Cambodia utilization ramps with stable gross margin and cash conversion.
Fenglin Medical integration turns profitable without further balance-sheet deterioration.
New Class III arterial blood-sampling product demonstrates material domestic revenue and margin.
kill_thesis: FDA import alert remains unresolved or expands in scope.
Deduct-net-profit margin fails to normalize despite revenue growth.
Inventory/capex/acquisition working capital continues to absorb cash faster than core profit grows.
A recovery valuation remains dependent on a profit level materially above disclosed operating evidence.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Generous asset cushion is included; earnings are normalized rather than annualizing H1 revenue growth.

d2_questions: Test balance-sheet resilience, cash conversion and sustainable shareholder return.
Compare the opportunity with lower-risk defensive and cash alternatives.
Normalize earnings and cash flow using the latest primary financial disclosures.
Build an explicit valuation range and identify what expectations are embedded in the current price.
Define the first-rejection test and the evidence that would invalidate the thesis.
queue.first_rejection: Reject D2 promotion if balance-sheet, cash-conversion or normalized-return evidence does not support the defensive label.

catalysts: NIM stabilizes around or above current levels as deposit costs reprice down.
Watch and overdue loan ratios stabilize without translating into higher NPL formation.
Interim/full-year cash payout remains sustainable while capital ratios stay comfortably above minima.
Provision coverage remains high while earnings growth continues without relying on outsized bond-realization gains.
kill_thesis: NPL ratio moves above roughly 1.0-1.1% with simultaneous watch/overdue deterioration and rising credit cost.
NIM falls materially below roughly 1.45% without offsetting funding-cost or fee-income improvement.
Core Tier-1 capital falls toward roughly 12.5% while loan growth remains aggressive or capital actions dilute common holders.
Recurring earnings become increasingly dependent on bond/investment gains while core spread and credit economics weaken.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: P/B is primary because sustainable ROE, credit cost, capital generation and payout dominate bank economics.

catalysts: Q2 gross/net margin improvement persists through H2 without inventory build accelerating.
Thailand/overseas capacity reaches utilization with acceptable ROIC and cash conversion.
Industry capacity digestion improves stainless processing spreads.
Operating cash flow catches up with earnings while inventory and debt normalize.
kill_thesis: Gross margin mean-reverts toward or below roughly 4.5% without a temporary explanation.
Inventory, short-term funding and receivables continue rising faster than revenue while CFO remains below earnings.
New governance or related-party/control issues materially raise capital-allocation risk.
Convertible/dilution or expansion capex reduces per-share returns without a commensurate ROIC improvement.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Base sits around an improved but not peak normalized run-rate; Q2 is not annualized mechanically.
